name: Kamehameha
description: The signature energy wave: hands are cupped at the hip, energy is gathered, then released forward with full extension.

steps.instruction: Stand with feet planted shoulder-width apart.
Cup both hands together at your hip, palms facing each other.
Bend knees slightly and lower your center of gravity.
Drive both hands forward together in a straight line.
Fully extend both arms at the moment of release.
